title: Sources: China is drafting plans to spend $295B over the next five years on building AI data centers, sourcing 80%+ of tech from local suppliers like Huawei (Charlie Zhu/Bloomberg)
summary: Charlie Zhu / Bloomberg: Sources: China is drafting plans to spend $295B over the next five years on building AI data centers, sourcing 80%+ of tech from local suppliers like Huawei — China is preparing to spend around 2 trillion yuan ($295 billion) over the next five years on building data centers across the country …
